name: hypeauditor-marketing
description: Find and vet creators, uncover competitor strategies, and turn influencer insights into campaign action with HypeAuditor.

interface.longDescription: Turn your AI assistant into your influencer marketing workspace. Find the right creators on Instagram, YouTube and TikTok, check audience quality and authenticity, and compare talent with real HypeAuditor data. See which content performs, discover who works with competing brands, and turn research into a shortlist you can act on. Work with your reports, creator lists, campaigns, media plans and brand mentions directly in the conversation, then export the results. From your first brief to your next campaign update, get the insights and actions you need without switching between tabs.
defaultPrompt: Find creators for my next campaign.
Compare these creators and their audiences.
Compare Nike and Adidas creator mentions on TikTok over the last 30 days.
